name: WP-MVP-0002 EOSR F001 Correction Bootstrap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - wp/mvp-0002-eosr-f001-bootstrap

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  correct:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact rejected-review baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="656257b5c6b5f7179297bba038b47eaebecddbdd"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/wp-mvp-0002-eosr-f001-bootstrap.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Apply explicit ReadDir item-error handling and regression
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs')
          text=p.read_text()
          text=text.replace(
              '    fmt, fs,\n    path::{Path, PathBuf},\n',
              '    ffi::OsString,\n    fmt, fs, io,\n    path::{Path, PathBuf},\n',
              1,
          )
          old='''                let mut entries = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).collect::<Vec<_>>();\n                entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());\n                for entry in entries {\n                    self.walk_entry(&entry.path(), ancestors);\n                }\n'''
          new='''                let (entries, errors) = collect_directory_entries(entries.map(|entry| {\n                    entry.map(|entry| (entry.file_name(), entry.path()))\n                }));\n                let location = relative_utf8(self.root, directory);\n                for error in errors {\n                    self.diagnostic(\n                        DiscoveryDiagnosticCode::UnreadableSource,\n                        format!("cannot enumerate directory entry: {error}"),\n                        location.clone(),\n                    );\n                }\n                for (_, path) in entries {\n                    self.walk_entry(&path, ancestors);\n                }\n'''
          assert old in text
          text=text.replace(old,new,1)
          anchor='''        fn walk_entry(&mut self, path: &Path, ancestors: &mut BTreeSet<PathBuf>) {\n'''
          helper='''        fn walk_entry(&mut self, path: &Path, ancestors: &mut BTreeSet<PathBuf>) {\n'''
          # Insert pure collection helper immediately before the Walker impl.
          walker='''          struct Walker<'a> {\n'''
          idx=text.index(walker)
          end=text.index("\n          impl Walker<'_> {", idx)
          helper_code='''\n          fn collect_directory_entries<I>(\n              entries: I,\n          ) -> (Vec<(OsString, PathBuf)>, Vec<io::Error>)\n          where\n              I: IntoIterator<Item = io::Result<(OsString, PathBuf)>>,\n          {\n              let mut valid = Vec::new();\n              let mut errors = Vec::new();\n              for entry in entries {\n                  match entry {\n                      Ok(entry) => valid.push(entry),\n                      Err(error) => errors.push(error),\n                  }\n              }\n              valid.sort_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(&right.0));\n              (valid, errors)\n          }\n'''
          text=text[:end]+helper_code+text[end:]
          test_anchor='''              #[test]\n              fn discovery_is_sorted_and_merges_overlapping_pattern_provenance() {\n'''
          regression='''              #[test]\n              fn directory_entry_errors_are_preserved_while_valid_entries_sort() {\n                  let input = vec![\n                      Ok((OsString::from("z.md"), PathBuf::from("z.md"))),\n                      Err(io::Error::new(\n                          io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied,\n                          "simulated directory entry failure",\n                      )),\n                      Ok((OsString::from("a.md"), PathBuf::from("a.md"))),\n                  ];\n                  let (entries, errors) = collect_directory_entries(input);\n                  let names = entries\n                      .iter()\n                      .map(|(name, _)| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())\n                      .collect::<Vec<_>>();\n                  assert_eq!(names, ["a.md", "z.md"]);\n                  assert_eq!(errors.len(), 1);\n                  assert_eq!(errors[0].kind(), io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied);\n                  assert_eq!(errors[0].to_string(), "simulated directory entry failure");\n              }\n\n'''
          assert test_anchor in text
          text=text.replace(test_anchor,regression+test_anchor,1)
          p.write_text(text)
          PY

      - name: Full Rust validation and machine synchronization
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
          rustup override set 1.95.0
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert correction scope and finding coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          text=Path('crates/monad-core/src/discovery.rs').read_text()
          assert 'filter_map(Result::ok)' not in text
          assert 'cannot enumerate directory entry: {error}' in text
          assert 'directory_entry_errors_are_preserved_while_valid_entries_sort' in text
          review=Path('engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0002-REVIEW.md').read_text()
          assert '**Decision:** REJECTED' in review and 'EOSR-WP-MVP-0002-F001' in review
          wp=Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in wp
          PY
          allowed='^(crates/monad-core/src/discovery\.rs|machine/)'
          unexpected="$(git diff --name-only | grep -Ev "$allowed" || true)"
          test -z "$unexpected" || { printf 'Unexpected correction scope:\n%s\n' "$unexpected" >&2; exit 1; }
          git diff --stat

      - name: Commit product correction
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git config user.name 'ChatGPT'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'fix(workspace): diagnose directory entry errors'

      - name: Refresh dependent EOSV evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit evidence refresh prove final and publish
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="wp/mvp-0002-eosr-f001"
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '^(crates/|src/|.*\.rs$|product/|architecture/|specifications/|engineering/work-packets/|engineering/work-cycles/|engineering/reviews/)'; then
            echo 'Unexpected semantic/product change in evidence refresh.' >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git commit -m 'chore(eosv): refresh evidence after WP-MVP-0002 review correction'
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-list --count 656257b5c6b5f7179297bba038b47eaebecddbdd..HEAD)" = "2"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Final correction branch exists' >&2; exit 1; fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
